Every entry needs a reason. Read by e2e/tests/readability.spec.ts; see docs/design/READABILITY_PLAN.md.

POLISH U2 (N2): a phase with nothing reviewed reads 'none' beside an empty track, not '0% · 0/0' in red.

POLISH U5 (N7): a mistake card said POSITIONAL twice, as its motif badge and again as the verified consequence badge. The motif badge stays; the repeat goes. (The checked commentary that repeated the diagnosis word for word also goes; it is prose, so parity does not count it.)
